rationale: With helicopter scanning complete and this being our final wave, we are deploying all three drones to resolve critical life-safety gaps. Drone 1 will verify trapped survivors at California Bank and Trust and resolve high-occupancy damage disagreements along California and Pine Streets. Drones 2 and 3 will sweep high-risk unscanned blocks in SoMa and the Financial District—including the Rincon Annex, 50 Fremont Center, and the unassessed 475 Sansome Street block—leaving no drones in reserve.

missions.purpose: Confirm trapped survivors at California Bank and Trust and verify damage at 255 California, 201 California, and 100 Pine Center.
Verify Hyatt Regency damage and survey unscanned high-occupancy buildings at Rincon Annex, PG&E Building, and Park Tower.
Assess the high-risk 475 Sansome Street block where severe collapse is predicted and helicopter views were obstructed.
